message.abstract: <jats:p>Exome sequencing of 118 patients with neurodevelopmental disorders shows that this technique is useful for identifying new pathogenic mutations and for correcting diagnosis in ~10% of cases.</jats:p>
title: Exome Sequencing Can Improve Diagnosis and Alter Patient Management
